title: Rabbi Binyamin
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He was Rabbi Akiva’s student, speaking in his name in Semachot, beginning of chapter 9: “Rabbi Binyamin says in the name of Rabbi Akiva: One rends the undershirt,” etc. He disagrees with Rabbi Elazar (ben Shamua), as in Ketubot 84a, where they said: “As the Tannaim dispute: Rabbi Binyamin says, ‘to the weakest of the claims, and that is proper’; Rabbi Elazar says,” etc.
He is likewise mentioned in baraitot in Menachot 71a and Niddah 21b.

notes.text: אפיקרסין here means undershirts, not heretics. Saved Vilna digital Tractate Semachot 9:6 places the term among laws of rending garments, and A. Cohen’s Soncino English explicitly translates Rabbi Binyamin’s ruling as rending the undershirt. This corrects an error missed by the reviewer’s PASS. The Elazar ben Shamua identification remains Hyman’s supplied parenthesis.
